name: Andrés Ojanguren-Affilastro
title: Museo Argentino de Ciencias Naturales, Buenos Aires, Argentina | AMNH Collections Study Grant
bio: Andrés' PhD research was a revision of the diverse South American bothriurid genus *Brachistosternus*. He visited the AMNH twice, the first time to extract, amplify and sequence DNA from bothriurid samples and a second time to continue his work on bothriurid systematics.
